articles.title: France set to take part in U20 Women's World Cup despite Uefa boycott threat
articles.summary: France say they are still planning to compete in the Under-20 Women's World Cup next month despite a threat from Uefa to boycott Fifa competitions.

articles.title: Who will exit Chelsea? How Blues could cut 41-man squad
articles.summary: With 25 days until the transfer window closes, Chelsea will be working hard to cut their 41-man senior squad. But who could be heading out?

articles.title: Draper will play Cincinnati Open despite arm injury fears
articles.summary: Jack Draper has been confirmed for next week's Cincinnati Open despite being left in a flood of tears following defeat at the National Bank Open in Montreal.
